buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Superintending Engineer Electricity Distribution Circle Orai . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses AS PER ATC 1. The contractor shall employee sufficient trained man power and T&P so that the work may be compl eted in time from the date of execution and start the work from the date of LOI/Agreement and work must be completed within the stipulated period. 2. All skilled labours and T&P, grouting material shall be provided by firm and work will be carried out

as per RESPO/DVVNL Norms. Rest material shall be provided by the department. 3. The contractor shall be entirely responsible of the material till completion of the work to the satisfac tion of the Engineer of Contract and the Concerned Executive Engineer. 4. The contractor shall be solely responsible for any losses/damages to the persons working with/unde r him and shall have to pay due compensation in accordance with prevailing rules. 5. Regulation of Government/Contractor shall to have group insurance for labours engaged by him and shall have to pay due compensation in accordance with the same. The corporation will bear no resp onsibility for the compensation to his labours in case of any man handling accident. 6. The contractor shall ensure payment of wages to their labour as per provision of labour act. 7. The contractor shall be solely responsible for any loss or the theft of the damages to the material ta ken from the DVVNL Agra/UPPCL Lucknow as long as the works given herein are completed to the sa tisfaction of the corporation representative and accord ingly shall have to keep adequate watch & w ard any losses damages accident theft etc. to the materials of the corporation. 8. Payment shall be made by the Executive Engineer, Electricity Distribution Division-I, Orai to the con tractor after Submission of satisfactory Work completion report & measurement. 9. TPIA INSPECTION:- TPIA Inspection of all works is mandatory under this Agreement/ Tender. 10. Income tax, GST, TDS, Labour cess and all other taxes as per rule will be deducted as applicable at t he time of payment from the contractor bills. 11. All latest rules and regulation of UPPCL/DVVNL shall be applicable for completion of work. 12. The Above Terms & Conditions Shall Prevail and Supersede Any Contradictory Provisions Appearing Elsewhere In The Gem Bid Document/Contract. . 7.
